title: Light Norwegian Chorizo Tagine
description: A tangy and flaky post-workout Norwegian dish featuring chorizo, made in a tagine pot and spherified for a unique texture, this recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a light dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb broth, Norwegian cheese, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate and calcium chloride with a little water to create a spherification bath.
Drop small amounts of the chorizo mixture into the spherification bath and let them sit for 1 minute to form spheres.
Remove the spheres from the bath with a slotted spoon and add them to the tagine pot.
Simmer the tagine for an additional 5 minutes, then stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the tagine cool slightly before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
